scope.call_count_meaning: Python dispatcher invocations, including startup/eager/capture. Not workload weights or GPU replay counts.
scope.compiled_calls: Recording is bypassed while torch.compiler.is_compiling(). Python operator calls outside that trace, including observed DSpark calls, are recorded; this does not cover every GEMM lowered into compiled code.
scope.coverage: Only the installed low-level capture hooks; excluded calls and out-of-contract GEMM are listed separately.
scope.moe_expert_axis: n_experts counts local experts. With no expert_mask, global_experts is absent from the schema and its Point placeholder is not a model expert count.
scope.phase_meaning: eager includes startup and inference; capture records graph construction, not each later replay.
scope.role_meaning: Raw labels or layer prefixes from hooks. DSpark's fused context K/V projection (n=1280, k=6144) reuses its first qkv_proj prefix; the routed MoE role is a hook label.
scope.target_source: Complete arch/hardware pairs from actual CallRecords; no target widening.
scope.workload_selection: Unique observed Points; all normalized scalar values at each Point must agree.
